title: Mini Tacos
instructions: Measure 5-6oz. 96/4 lean beef. Mix in 2-3 tbsp of your favorite taco seasoning.
Heat up beef in a nonstick skillet on medium heat for 7-8 minutes or until no pink is showing.
Add 1/4 cup water and 2 tbsp store bought enchilada sauce and bring to a simmer.
Once cooked and the sauce thickens within the beef, transfer to a bowl and add 36g of fat free cheese. Mix ingredients.
Get 12 low calorie (25 calorie tortillas) and equally distribute beef filling into each of them.
Air fry 400 for five minutes or fry each side of each taco in a pan.
Cilantro lime: mix ingredients and blend until smooth.

title: Pizza Bagel Bites
ingredients: 75g of power flour or self rising flour (adjust macros)
Salt, pepper, garlic over the top
instructions: In a large bowl mix 75g of power flour or self rising flour along with 120g nonfat Greek yogurt.
Use a spoon and combine ingredients until the dough breaks into multiple small pieces.
Place some flour on your hands and turn those smaller pieces into one large ball of dough.
Roll out your ball of dough as large as possible. Using a small cup, cut out 24 dough circles.
Combine the 24 circles into 12 by stacking them onto one another.
Then disperse the above measured ingredients across your 12 bagel bites.
Place them on parchment paper, onto a cookie sheet and bake at 400 for 10-15 minutes.

title: Cheesy Chicken Taquitos
ingredients: 112g fat free or reduced fat cheese (half reduced half fat free)
instructions: Cook down 16 oz. of 96/4 ground chicken in a nonstick pan at high heat (use avocado spray).
Add 3-4 tbsp of your favorite taco seasoning.
Cook down for 10-11 minutes while chopping until the ground chicken is cooked through and has browned edges.
In a large bowl, toss your cooked ground chicken, 3 tbsp diced chiles or jalapeños, and 112g of light cheese. Do 56g fat free and 56g reduced fat cheese.
Combine all ingredients thoroughly then disperse onto 10 mission carb balance tortillas.
Roll them up tight, hit them with avocado spray and air fry 400 for 5 minutes.

title: Corn Dogs
ingredients: 4 links (open nature red pepper and garlic)
1 cup power flour OR self rising flour (macros adjusted)
instructions: In a bowl combine 1 cup self rising flour or 1 cup power flour, with 5 packets of stevia, and 15g of cornmeal.
Whisk those ingredients together then add 100ml of fat free fairlife milk and 1-2 tbsp of honey.
Continue to whisk ingredients together until smooth.
Get your natures own link or low cal hot dog equivalent and stick a Popsicle through the bottom.
Dip into corn dog batter until fully coated.
Place on parchment paper and air fry at 400 for 10 minutes.
macroNote: Per corn dog: 201 calories, 10g carbs, 8g fat, 22g protein.

title: Classic Party Pizza
ingredients: 3/4 cup power flour or self rising flour
10oz. cooked beef (season w/ garlic, onion, Italian)
instructions: In a large bowl combine 3/4 cup of self rising flour or power flour, and 120-130g nonfat Greek yogurt.
Mix with a spoon until the dough gets clumpy, then flour your hands and push it into one large dough ball.
Get a large sheet of parchment paper, hit it with pam oil, then roll your dough as large as possible.
Place on a baking sheet and bake at 400 for 10 minutes.
Take out of the oven and hit the dough with 10g pizza sauce, 56g fat free mozzarella, 28g reduced fat mozzarella, 10 oz. cooked beef, 8g turkey pepperoni, and 1.5 chopped slice of canadian bacon.
Place in the oven at 400 for 7-8 more minutes or until desired crispiness.

title: Tasty Shred Pizza Rolls
instructions: Take out 14 low calorie mini taco tortillas. I suggest 25 calorie mission tortilla brand.
Hit each one with 5g of pizza sauce.
Give each tortilla a thin slice of provolone, 7g of turkey pepperoni, and 5g of fat free mozzarella.
Fold them like a burrito, then crimp the corners by using a fork and pressing down around all of the edges.
Using a silicone brush, swipe each one with a hint of egg wash, then coat some powdered parmesan over each one.
Place in the air fryer at 400 degrees for approximately 10 minutes or until desired crispiness.

title: Shred Pockets
ingredients: 5 carb balance mission tortillas (110 cal ones)
seasonings: crushed pepper flakes, Italian seasoning, salt, ground pepper, parsley flakes, onion powder (1-2tsp of each)
instructions: In a bowl add 8oz. of raw 93/7 beef. Add to it these seasonings: crushed red pepper flakes, Italian seasoning, salt, ground pepper, parsley flakes and onion powder (1-2 tsp of each depending on your personal flavor profile).
Hand mix the seasonings in the beef with gloves then throw into a skillet on high heat with olive oil spray on the surface.
Cook your ground beef while chopping until no pink is showing, then place in a clean bowl.
Chop 12 slices canadian bacon, 10 slices thin provolone, 50g of turkey pepperoni and add to the beef bowl.
Add 100g of pizza sauce in that same bowl and mix the ingredients together.
Equally distribute pizza filling onto tortilla, wrap into a burrito, crimp the sides with a fork and air fry 400 for 10 mins.

title: Cheddar Bacon Fries
ingredients: 2 slices thin cheddar or thin mozzarella
For protein ranch: 340g nonfat Greek yogurt
instructions: Wash and peel the russet potatoes. Cut them into fries or wedges, depending on your preference. Toss them in a little salt and garlic parmesan for added flavor.
Place the bacon slices in the air fryer basket and cook at 375°F (190°C) for about 8-10 minutes or until crispy. Remove, crumble into pieces, and set aside.

Toss the potatoes with a small amount of oil (optional) and place them in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until golden and crisp.
If using pre-cooked chicken breasts, season them with salt and garlic parmesan, then air fry at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes or until cooked through.

In a blender, combine 340g nonfat Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp ranch seasoning, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Blend until smooth and well-mixed. Adjust seasonings to taste if needed.

Once the fries are cooked, remove them from the air fryer and transfer them to a plate or baking sheet. Top with shredded fat-free cheddar, diced bacon, and crumbled bacon. Place the loaded fries back into the air fryer and cook at 375°F (190°C) for 3-5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
Drizzle the protein ranch over the top of the loaded fries. You can add extra seasoning if desired. Serve immediately and enjoy your delicious chicken bacon fries!

title: Chicken Garlic Parm Taquitos
ingredients: seasonings: salt pepper, smoked paprika, lemon pepper, garlic powder
instructions: Season the chicken tenderloin with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, cracked lemon pepper, and garlic powder. Cook the chicken in the air fryer at 375°F (190°C) for about 12-15 minutes, or until fully cooked.
Shred the chicken once it's cooked and set aside.
Cook the center-cut bacon in the air fryer at 375°F (190°C) for 8-10 minutes or until crispy. Drain on paper towels and crumble into small pieces.
In a mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, sautéed onions, garlic, 4-5 tbsp spicy garlic parmesan seasoning, 56g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, and 13g parmesan cheese. Mix well.
Place a slice of provolone cheese on each low-calorie wrap. Spoon the chicken mixture evenly onto each wrap. Roll the wraps tightly to form taquitos.

Lightly spray the air fryer basket with non-stick spray. Place the taquitos in the basket, making sure they are not overcrowded. Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 8-10 minutes, or until the taquitos are crispy and golden brown. You may need to do this in batches.

Remove the taquitos from the air fryer and let them cool slightly. Garnish with crumbled bacon and chopped chives. Serve with additional spicy garlic parmesan seasoning or your favorite low-calorie dipping sauce if desired.

title: Steak and Bacon Bagel
ingredients: 5 killer daves bagels (260 cals or less equivalent)
instructions: Cook the 10 slices of center-cut bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Drain on paper towels and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the 5 oz of shaved beef until browned and cooked through. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat and set aside.
Pour the 500g of egg whites or egg beaters into a non-stick skillet or pan. Season with salt and pepper. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked and scrambled. Set aside.
Slice the Killer Dave's bagels in half and toast to your desired crispiness.
On the bottom half of each bagel, layer 2 slices of bacon, a portion of the cooked shaved beef, and some of the scrambled egg whites. Top with a slice of reduced-fat cheese.

Place the top half of the bagel on each sandwich. If you want the cheese to melt, you can briefly microwave each sandwich for a minute or place them in a toaster oven for a minute. Serve immediately and enjoy your healthy breakfast sandwiches!

title: Chipotle BBQ Nuggets
instructions: Cut the 12oz lean chicken breast into bite-sized nugget pieces. Season with salt, pepper, cayenne pepper, and paprika to taste. (makes 12)
In a blender or food processor, combine 25g chipotle peppers in adobo with 4 tbsp low-cal BBQ sauce. Blend until smooth. This will be used to coat the chicken nuggets.
Dip each chicken piece into the whisked eggs, ensuring it is fully coated. Then coat each piece with the chipotle BBQ sauce mixture, making sure it's well covered.
Place the crushed corn flakes in a shallow dish. Press each sauce-coated chicken nugget into the crushed corn flakes to coat thoroughly.

Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Arrange the coated nuggets in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook for 8-10 minutes, or until crispy and cooked through. You may need to do this in batches depending on the size of your air fryer.
Once the nuggets are cooked, remove them from the air fryer and let them rest for a couple of minutes. Garnish with chopped chives for added flavor and a fresh touch.
Serve the BBQ chipotle chicken nuggets with additional low-cal BBQ sauce for dipping. Enjoy your crispy, flavorful nuggets!

title: Stuff Crust Meat Attack Pizza
ingredients: For the pizza: 2 carb balance Mission tortillas
instructions: Preheat the oven.

In a bowl, mix the ground beef with Italian and garlic seasoning. Form into small meatballs (about 1-inch in size). Preheat air fryer to 375°F (190°C) and cook meatballs for 8-10 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through.

Prepare the tortillas: lay one tortilla flat on a clean surface. Place the chopped light mozzarella sticks around the edge of the tortilla and fold the edge over to create a stuffed crust. Press to seal.
Stack the second tortilla: place the stuffed tortilla on top of the second tortilla to create a double-layer base. Press down gently.
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) while preparing the pizza.

Spread the pizza sauce evenly over the top of the stacked tortillas. Add the cooked mini meatballs, turkey pepperoni, chopped center-cut bacon, provolone pieces, fat-free mozzarella, and reduced-fat mozzarella evenly on top.
Transfer the assembled pizza onto a baking sheet or pizza stone. Bake in the preheated oven for about 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
Slice and serve.

title: Cheesy Protein Fiesta Bowl
ingredients: 300g protein ranch (300g nonfat greek yogurt, 4 garlic cloves, 1tbsp hidden valley ranch seasoning, 2 tbsp onion powder, and blend)
instructions: Wash then cube 2-3 medium russet potatoes. Baptize them in water for 30 minutes, drain, dry, and toss them in a bowl olive oil spray, salt, pepper, paprika and taco seasoning. Bake in the air fryer 400 for 25-30 mins or until desired crispness.
Blend the nonfat greek yogurt, garlic cloves, hidden valley ranch seasoning, onion powder, and blend until smooth. Set aside.

Cook the beef in a skillet over medium heat, add the 93/7 ground beef, season with taco seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper, cook until browned and cooked through, about 7-10 minutes, drain any excess fat.
While the potatoes and beef are cooking, dice the red onion and tomato, and slice the green onion for garnish.
Cut the potatoes once they are cooked, let them cool slightly, then cut them in half lengthwise and gently fluff the insides with a fork.
Layer ingredients: spoon the cooked ground beef over the fluffed potatoes, drizzle with nacho cheese, and top with the protein ranch mixture.
Garnish: sprinkle diced red onion, chopped tomato, and sliced green onion on top. Serve immediately and enjoy your cheesy protein fiesta potato bowl! Put into four separate servings.

title: Surf and Turf Loaded Fries
ingredients: seasonings: cajun, garlic, taco, salt, pepper, smoked paprika
instructions: Prepare the potato: wash and air fry the russet potato into fries (about 1/4-inch thick). Toss with salt, pepper, and a sprinkle of cajun seasoning. Place in the air fryer basket at 400°F (200°C) for about 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy.

Cook and sear the steak: while the fries are cooking, season the sirloin steak with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Remove from the skillet and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté the shrimp: heat the same skillet, add the cooked shrimp along with a dash of cajun seasoning and taco seasoning. Sauté for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Combine the ingredients: once the fries are done, transfer to a serving plate. Top with the sautéed shrimp and the sliced steak.
Drizzle sauces: drizzle the protein chipotle sauce over the loaded fries, then add the nacho cheese on top.
Garnish and enjoy: if desired, garnish with chopped green onions or cilantro. Serve immediately and enjoy your surf n turf loaded fries!

title: Crunch Wrap Supreme
ingredients: 100g nonfat greek yogurt chipotle sauce (mix with chipotle in adobo, cilantro, garlic, and lime)
instructions: Prepare the sauce: in a small bowl, combine the nonfat Greek yogurt, chipotle in adobo, chopped cilantro, minced garlic, and a squeeze of lime. Mix well and set aside. (blend it)
Cook the ground beef: in a skillet over medium heat, add the ground beef. Season with salt, pepper, and taco seasoning. Cook until browned and fully cooked, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess fat.

Assemble the wrap: on the large tortilla, spread a layer of the chipotle sauce, then sprinkle with reduced-fat cheddar cheese, lettuce, diced tomato, and drizzle with nacho cheese. Place the smaller tortilla on top.
Fold the crunch wrap: carefully fold the edges of the large tortilla over the center to create pleats. Make sure to fully enclose the filling.

Cook in skillet: with a small amount of oil in the skillet over medium heat, place the folded crunch wrap seam-side down in the skillet. Cook for about 3-4 minutes until golden brown, then flip and cook the other side for another 3-4 minutes.
Slice and enjoy: remove the crunch wrap from the skillet, let it cool slightly, then slice in half and serve. Enjoy your homemade crunch wrap supreme!

title: Classic Baconator
instructions: Place 16 slices of center cut bacon on a baking sheet. Using parchment paper is helpful but not mandatory. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until desired crispiness and set aside.
Form and season the patties: make 8, 2oz. 93/7 beef balls and flatten them into patties, then cut around the parchment paper and stack the patties. Salt and pepper each side.

In a skillet or grill, cook your burgers on high heat for 4-5 minutes per side or until internal temp reaches 135 or higher. Place a slice of velveeta cheese on 4 of the 8 patties and cook until the cheese melts.
While the burgers are finishing, in another skillet (or the same one if you prefer), toast the oro wheat keto buns cut side down until golden brown. This should take about 2-3 minutes.

On the bottom half of each toasted bun, layer the cooked burger patty, followed by crispy bacon, sliced onion, and sliced jalapeño. Top with the other half of the bun. Serve immediately and enjoy your delicious bacon cheeseburgers!
Sauce: mix light mayo, light ketchup, relish, paprika and mustard and white vinegar 1-2 tbsp of each and enjoy.

title: Mini Poblano Chicken Tacos
ingredients: greek based jalapeño cilantro ranch: 200g nonfat greek yogurt
instructions: Prepare the chicken: season the chicken breast with taco seasoning and cook it in a skillet over medium heat until fully cooked (about 6-8 minutes per side). Let it rest for a few minutes, then shred or dice the chicken.
Roast the poblano peppers: while the chicken is cooking, slice up your poblano peppers and sauté at medium heat on high.
Make the ranch dressing: in a bowl, combine nonfat Greek yogurt, ranch seasoning, onion powder, and adjust the consistency with a splash of milk until smooth if necessary.

Assemble the tacos: warm the sundried tomato tortillas in a dry skillet for a few seconds on each side. Fill each tortilla with shredded chicken, roasted poblano slices, and a slice of provolone cheese.
Heat the tacos: place the assembled tacos back in the skillet over medium heat, cooking until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are slightly crispy (about 2-3 minutes per side).
Serve the tacos with a drizzle of the jalapeño cilantro ranch dressing, fresh cilantro, and lime wedges for squeezing. Feel free to adjust the ingredients and seasoning to suit your taste.

title: Gym N Out Fries
instructions: Wash and peel the russet potatoes. Slice them into fry-shaped pieces. Soak the sliced potatoes in cold water for at least 30 minutes. This helps remove excess starch and makes them crispier.

Drain the soaked potatoes and pat them dry with paper towels. Preheat your air fryer according to the manufacturer's instructions. Lightly season the fries with salt and pepper, then place them in the air fryer basket. Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until golden and crispy.

While the fries are cooking, season the sirloin steak with salt and pepper. Add a little oil. Once hot, add the steak and cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side for medium-rare, or until desired doneness. Remove from the skillet and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
In the same skillet, add the sliced white onion and sauté over medium heat until they are caramelized and soft (about 5-7 minutes). You can add a pinch of salt to enhance the flavor.
In a bowl, mix the light mayo, mustard, light ketchup, minced pickles or relish, a sprinkle of paprika, and a dash of white vinegar. Stir well and adjust seasoning to taste. Set aside.
On a plate, assemble your dish: fries, steak, caramelized onions, melted cheese, and drizzle with thirty grams of sauce.

title: Mexican Pizza
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Season the ground beef with taco seasoning and cook until browned and fully cooked (about 5-7 minutes). Drain any excess fat if necessary.
In a blender combine 1/4 cup enchilada sauce and 50g fat free cottage cheese.
Place one carb balance tortilla on a baking sheet. Spread half of the enchilada sauce evenly over the tortilla.
Layer the ingredients: spread half of the cooked ground beef, add nacho cheese, and the rest of the cheddar cheese.

Add the second tortilla: place the second tortilla on top of the first one. Repeat the layering process with the remaining enchilada sauce, ground beef, nacho cheese, and the rest of the cheddar cheese.
Bake the pizza: place the assembled pizza in the preheated oven and bake for about 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish and serve: once out of the oven, top the pizza with the cubed tomato and chopped green onion. Cut into slices and enjoy your delicious Mexican pizza!

title: Southwest Steak Burrito
ingredients: 8 mission carb balance tortillas (10 cal or equivalent)
instructions: Cook the bacon: in a skillet, cook the 9 slices of center-cut bacon until crispy. Remove and chop into small pieces.
Sauté vegetables: in the same skillet, add the diced white onion, green bell pepper, and red bell pepper. Sauté until softened. Add salt, pepper, and garlic to taste.
Cook the steak: add the shaved steak or ribeye to the skillet with the vegetables. Cook until the beef is browned and cooked through.

Make the chipotle sauce: in a blender, combine 240g nonfat greek yogurt, 3 garlic cloves, a splash of fat-free milk, 30g chipotle in adobo, 1 tbsp cilantro, 1 tbsp onion powder, and a splash of white vinegar. Blend until smooth.
Assemble the burritos: on each tortilla, layer the beef and vegetable mixture, chopped bacon, 2 tbsp nacho cheese, and a slice of provolone.
Wrap and serve: roll up each tortilla to form a burrito. You can heat them in the skillet for a few minutes to melt the cheese and serve with the chipotle sauce on the side.

title: Healthy Pizza Dippers
ingredients: 90g chipotle sauce (see previous recipe to make)
or use low cal marinara sauce
instructions: Prepare the filling: in a bowl, combine the chopped turkey deli meat, chopped turkey pepperoni, and provolone strips. Mix well.
Prepare the flatbread: lay the joseph's lavash flatbread flat on a clean surface.
Assemble the wrap: spread the chipotle sauce evenly over the flatbread, then place the meat and cheese mixture in the center of the flatbread.

Wrap and air fry: roll the flatbread tightly around the filling to form a burrito. Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Place the burrito seam-side down in the air fryer basket and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the flatbread is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Serve hot, and enjoy your delicious burrito-style wrap!
Feel free to make a yogurt based chipotle sauce or just fill them with a low cal marinara sauce.

title: Healthy Protein Nuggets
instructions: Measure out 9oz. of 96/4 ground chicken and place into a large bowl. Add garlic powder, onion powder, 20g reduced fat cheddar, mustard and mix evenly. With wet hands make 16 individual chicken shaped discs to your desired thickness.
In a bowl, whisk an egg and in a separate bowl add about 1/2 cup of flour. Just know you will only be using about 1/4 of a cup rather than the entire 1/2 cup.
To make it a bit easier you can freeze those nuggets for 1 hr before using the dipping stations.
Once the nuggets are slightly frozen and less malleable dip into the egg wash one at a time and then into your flour.
Once all nuggets have been dipped and coated with flour hit the top of your nuggets with avocado oil spray.
Place in an air fryer at 400 degrees for approximately 13-16 minutes. (Make sure internal temp reaches 165 or higher before serving)
macroNote: Only calories and protein were listed for this recipe in the source book.

title: Pepper Jacked Crunch Wrap
ingredients: 2 zero carb Mission tortillas (25 calories each)
instructions: Prepare the chicken: if not cooked, season and cook the chicken breast in a skillet. Once cooked, shred it and mix with the chipotle protein sauce.

Layer the wraps: on each extreme wellness wrap, place a zero carb Mission tortilla on top. In the center, add shredded chicken, shredded lettuce, diced tomato, light cheese, nacho cheese, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Wrap it up: fold the edges of the extreme wellness wrap over the filling to form a circular shape.
Cook the wraps: heat a skillet on medium. Place the wraps seam-side down and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until golden and crispy.
Serve: cut in half and enjoy!
Enjoy your quick and delicious crunch wrap supremes!

title: Jalapeno Ranch Fries
ingredients: For the jalapeño ranch sauce: 300g nonfat greek yogurt
instructions: Make the jalapeño ranch sauce: in a blender, combine the nonfat greek yogurt, fat-free milk, ranch seasoning, onion powder, white vinegar, chopped jalapeños, and chipotle in adobo sauce. Blend until smooth and set aside.
Prepare the potatoes: cut the russet potatoes into fries. Soak them in water for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Season with paprika, chipotle seasoning, and salt.

Air fry the fries: preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Place the seasoned potato fries in the air fryer basket. Cook for about 15-20 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until crispy and cooked through.

Cook the beef: while the fries are cooking, heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the 95/5 beef, seasoning with salt and chipotle seasoning. Cook until browned and fully cooked, breaking it apart as it cooks.
Prepare the toppings: in a bowl, combine the cubed tomato, cubed white onion, and chopped cilantro. Mix well.

Assemble and serve: once the fries are done, plate them and top with the cooked beef, nacho cheese, and the tomato-onion-cilantro mixture. Drizzle generously with the jalapeño ranch sauce for a flavorful and macro-friendly meal.

title: Birria Queso Protein Bowl
instructions: Guajillo Prep: deseed the guajillo peppers first, then drop them into a wide pot of boiling water and let them roll at a steady boil for 10-12 minutes until softened and the kitchen smells like dried pepper tea. Drain, set aside to steam dry for a minute, then move straight into the blender.

Birria Sauce: add the boiled guajillos, 50 g chipotle in adobo, 6 garlic cloves, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, splash apple cider vinegar, 2 bay leaves, and 1 cup of bone broth into a high-speed blender and run until the sauce turns into a spreadable, aerated red puree that looks whipped, not watery, carrying deep pepper sweetness with smoky chipotle heat.

Beef Cook: place the cubed top sirloin into the slow cooker, pour the birria sauce evenly over the surface, add 1 more cup bone broth in a wide pour, season aggressively with salt and cracked black pepper, then slow-cook on LOW for 6-8 hours until the beef shreds under the slightest pressure from a fork.

Protein Queso Fold: pre-blend cottage cheese, cream cheese, 1 garlic clove, and 100 g Tostitos Salsa Con Queso until ultra-smooth, then pour the blended queso across the shredded beef in the crockpot and fold in broad, outward mixing motions until fully incorporated into a creamy birria-queso beef.
Spanish Rice: pre-blend 50 g chipotle with 2 cups bone broth, whisk in tomato paste and salt, scatter rice flat like a wide rice-sheet on the surface, then simmer until absorbed and fluffy.
Assemble Bowls: spoon rice into bowls first, layer with the creamy queso-folded birria beef, then finish with optional yogurt, lime, or cracked black pepper.
Optional: add some fresh avocado, and cojita cheese. Adjust macros accordingly and enjoy.

title: Pizza Pocket Burritos
ingredients: 3 lb (1360 g) raw, skinless chicken breast
instructions: Season + Sauce: place 3 lb (1360 g) chicken flat in the crockpot. Sprinkle 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp basil, 2 minced garlic cloves, ½ tsp salt, and ½ tsp pepper evenly across the top of the chicken. Pour 1½ cups (360 ml) pizza sauce over the surface to cover.
Slow Cook: cover and cook on LOW (≈190°F / 88°C) for 5-6 hours until the chicken shreds easily. If it doesn't, add +30 minutes.
Shred + Mix Cream Cheese: shred chicken in the pot. Add 120 g cream cheese and stir until mixed in (≈90 seconds to fully combine).
Pepperoni + Mozz Melt: add 100 g turkey pepperoni and 200 g mozzarella on top, cover, and cook 20 more minutes until fully melted.
Final Mix: stir everything together until creamy (30-45 seconds).

Portion + Wrap: add ≈140 g cheesy pizza chicken per tortilla. Add 1 provolone slice (≈10 g) per tortilla. Fold burrito-style and air fry at 375°F (190°C) for 6 minutes, flipping halfway (or pan-toast 3 minutes per side).

title: Chicken Parmesan Alfredo
ingredients: 2 cups bone broth (Kettle & Fire or similar)
18 oz Barilla Protein+ angel hair pasta
instructions: Spray slow cooker. Add 4 lb chicken breast, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, plus salt & pepper to taste.
Pour in 2 cups bone broth and add 40g Parmesan. Cover and cook LOW 6-7 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours, until chicken shreds easily.
In a blender, combine 600g fat-free cottage cheese, 100g reduced-fat cream cheese, 1 tbsp lemon juice, and remaining 40g Parmesan. Blend until completely smooth.
Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker, then pour in the blended sauce and stir until creamy and fully coated.
Cook 18 oz Barilla Protein+ angel hair pasta according to package directions, drain, and stir into the slow cooker.
Add 100g reduced-fat mozzarella, stir until melted and creamy, then portion into 10 equal servings and serve hot.

title: Buffalo Chicken Mac N Cheese
ingredients: ½ cup (120 ml) Frank's RedHot Buffalo Sauce
instructions: Slow Cooker Base: add 4 lb chicken breasts, 2 cups chicken broth, and ½ cup buffalo sauce to the slow cooker. Season with 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp salt, and ½ tsp black pepper.
Cook the Chicken: cover and cook on LOW for 6-7 hours or HIGH for 3-4 hours, until chicken shreds easily with forks.
Cook the Pasta: while chicken cooks, boil 16 oz cavatappi pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain and set aside.

Make the Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine 800 g fat-free cottage cheese, 200 g ⅓-less-fat cream cheese, 200 g reduced-fat cheddar, 200 g regular cheddar, and 2 packets mac & cheese powder. Blend until completely smooth. Add 2-4 tbsp chicken broth if needed to thin.
Shred & Combine: remove chicken from slow cooker and shred. Return chicken to cooker, then stir in cooked pasta and all blended cheese sauce until evenly coated.
Finish with Bacon: fold in 8 slices chopped center-cut bacon. Taste and adjust with extra buffalo sauce or salt if needed. Serve immediately or portion for meal prep.

title: Chicken Verde Nacho Burritos
instructions: Add 4 lb chicken breast, 1 cup salsa verde, 1 cup chicken broth, and ¼ cup taco seasoning to the slow cooker and add the ½ cup green chilis for extra heat. Stir lightly to coat chicken.
Cover and cook on LOW 6-7 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours, until chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken directly in the slow cooker using two forks and mix into the cooking liquid.
In a blender, combine 200 g cottage cheese, 75 g cream cheese, 250 g reduced-fat cheddar, 100 g mozzarella, and 100g queso blanco. Blend until smooth, adding 2-4 tbsp slow-cooker liquid if needed.
Pour cheese sauce into shredded chicken. Stir well, cover, and let sit on WARM 10-15 minutes until fully melted and creamy.
Lay out 11 tortillas and fill each with about 1 cup chicken nacho mixture. Roll into burritos. Optional: crisp in a skillet with light oil spray 1-2 minutes per side.
Allow to cool down for 20-30 mins then roll up in tin foil or meal container and refrigerate for 2-3 days or freeze for up to 30 days.

title: Cheddar Chicken Broccoli & Rice
ingredients: Minute Rice (enough dry rice to yield 5 cups cooked)
instructions: Add 4 lb chicken breast to the slow cooker. Season with 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp garlic salt, 2 tbsp ranch seasoning, 1 tbsp herbs & garlic seasoning, 1 tsp salt, and ½ tsp black pepper. Pour in 1 cup chicken bone broth.
Cover and cook on LOW 6-7 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours, until chicken is tender. Shred directly in the slow cooker.
In a blender, combine 800 g fat-free cottage cheese, 120 g reduced-fat cream cheese, 120g cheddar, and 2 packets mac & cheese powder. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Prepare Minute Rice separately, cooking enough dry rice to yield 5 cups cooked. Set aside.
During the last 30 minutes of slow cooking, pour in the blended cheese sauce. Add 200 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar and 2 cups broccoli florets. Stir well until melted and broccoli is tender.
Just before serving, fold in the 5 cups cooked rice. Mix until evenly combined and creamy.
macroNote: Meal-prep notes: stores 2-3 days refrigerated or freeze; reheats best with a splash of water or broth; great base for hot sauce, buffalo, or sriracha drizzle.

title: Slow Cooked Breakfast Burritos
ingredients: 10 Kirkland chicken sausage links (finely chopped or food-processed)
instructions: Spray the slow cooker with nonstick spray. Add 510 g frozen Potatoes O'Brien directly to the bottom and spread evenly.

Finely chop or food-process 10 chicken sausage links. Sauté in a skillet over medium heat with ½-1 tbsp taco seasoning and a light spray of oil for 4-5 minutes until heated through. Add sausage on top of the potatoes.
In a bowl, whisk 8 whole eggs with 400 g egg whites and ½ tbsp taco seasoning. Pour evenly over the potato-sausage mixture.
Cover and cook on HIGH 2-3 hours, until eggs are fully set.
During the last 30 minutes, sprinkle in 300 g reduced-fat cheddar and fold in 10 slices cooked, chopped center-cut bacon. Cover and let melt.
Spoon mixture evenly into 11 tortillas, roll into burritos, and serve or wrap for meal prep.
macroNote: Meal-prep notes: stores 2-3 days refrigerated; freezes well up to 2 months; reheat in air fryer or skillet for best texture.

title: Philly Steak and Rice Bowls
ingredients: 3.5 lb top sirloin steak, trimmed and cut into large chunks
4 cups dry instant white rice (Minute Rice)
½ cup hot water or broth (plus more as needed)
instructions: Spray slow cooker with nonstick spray. Add 3.5 lb sirloin, 1½ cups beef broth, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp soy sauce, bell peppers, onion, garlic, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp ranch powder, and salt & pepper to taste.
Cover and cook on LOW 6-7 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours, until steak shreds easily. Shred directly in the slow cooker and mix with juices and veggies.
While steak finishes, cook 4 cups dry instant rice according to package directions using water or broth. Fluff and set aside.

In a blender, combine 200 g cottage cheese, 62 g Rico's cheese sauce, 1 packet mac & cheese powder, 120 g reduced-fat cream cheese, and ½ cup hot water or broth. Blend until smooth and pourable, adding liquid 1 tbsp at a time if needed.
In the last 5 minutes of slow cooking, sprinkle 200 g reduced-fat mozzarella evenly over the steak mixture. Cover until melted.
To serve, portion ⅛ of the rice into each bowl, top with ⅛ of the steak & veggie mixture, and drizzle with cheese sauce just before serving.
macroNote: Meal-prep notes: stores 2-3 days refrigerated; reheats best with a splash of broth; optional add-ons: mushrooms, banana peppers, hot sauce.

title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta
ingredients: 2 cups low-sodium chicken bone broth (plus up to ½ cup extra if needed)
3 tsp ranch seasoning mix (plus 1 tsp extra for sauce)
instructions: Add 4 lb chicken breast, 2 cups chicken bone broth, 5 minced garlic cloves, 3 tsp ranch seasoning, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and salt & pepper to the slow cooker. Cook on LOW 6-7 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours, until chicken shreds easily.
While chicken cooks, pan-fry or air-fry 8 slices bacon until crispy (10-12 minutes). Chop and set aside.
In a blender, combine 700 g cottage cheese, 200 g reduced-fat cream cheese, 100 g Parmesan, and 1 tsp ranch seasoning. Blend until smooth, adding up to ½ cup extra bone broth only if needed to thin.
Shred chicken directly in the slow cooker and stir in the blended ranch cheese sauce until fully combined.
Boil 1 lb cavatappi pasta in salted water until al dente (8-10 minutes). Drain well and stir pasta into the creamy chicken mixture, adding a splash of broth if needed.
Sprinkle in 200 g reduced-fat mozzarella and mix until melted and creamy. Top with chopped bacon and fold in 1 cup chopped kale if using.
macroNote: Meal-prep notes: keeps 2-3 days refrigerated; reheat with a splash of broth or water; swap kale for spinach or peas if desired.

title: Mongolian Beef and Rice
ingredients: 4 lb top round beef, thinly sliced against the grain
2 stevia packets (or 1 tbsp brown sugar equivalent)
400g Minute white rice (dry, cooked per package directions)
instructions: (Optional but recommended) Lightly spray a skillet and sear sliced beef 2-3 minutes per side to lock in flavor.
Add beef to the slow cooker along with 1 cup bone broth, 1 cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp hoisin, 2 tbsp sriracha, 4 tbsp rice vinegar, garlic, bell pepper, jalapeños, and stevia. Stir to coat evenly.
Cover and cook on LOW 6 hours.
In the final hour, whisk 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2-3 tbsp broth until smooth. Stir into the slow cooker, switch to HIGH, and cook 1 additional hour until sauce thickens.
While sauce thickens, cook 400 g Minute rice according to package directions.
Portion 1/9 of the rice into each container, top with 1/9 of the Mongolian beef, and garnish with green onions or sesame seeds if desired.
macroNote: Meal-prep notes: stores 4-5 days refrigerated; sauce thickens more as it cools; swap rice for cauliflower rice for lower carbs.

title: Creamy Chicken Tortellini
instructions: Lightly spray the slow cooker. Add 4 lb chicken breast to the bottom and season evenly with 1 tbsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp Italian seasoning, 3 minced garlic cloves, salt, and pepper.
Pour 2 cups Rao's Homemade Marinara directly over the seasoned chicken, ensuring it's evenly coated.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6 hours (or HIGH for 3-4 hours) until the chicken is tender and easily shreddable.
In a blender, combine 350 g fat-free cottage cheese and 100 g reduced-fat cream cheese. Blend until completely smooth and creamy.
Shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker. Pour in the blended sauce, then stir in 100 g parmesan, 100 g reduced-fat mozzarella, and 4 cups Rana tortellini until fully coated.
Cover and cook on LOW for 20 minutes, until the tortellini is tender and the sauce thickens. Taste, adjust seasoning if needed, and portion into 10 high-protein servings.

title: Queso Chicken and Rice Bowls
ingredients: Chipotle peppers in adobo - ½ cup (~120 g)
Lime, juice + zest - 1 lime (~2 Tbsp juice + zest)
instructions: Season & Add Chicken: place 4 lb chicken breast into the slow cooker. Sprinkle evenly with 1 oz taco seasoning and pour in ½ cup chicken broth.
Slow Cook: cover and cook on LOW 6-7 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours, until the chicken is tender and easily shreddable.
Blend the Queso Sauce: in a blender, combine 600 g cottage cheese, 120 g cream cheese, 120 g cheese sauce, 72 g mac & cheese powder, and ½ cup chipotle peppers. Blend until smooth.
Shred & Add Sauce (final 30 minutes): shred the chicken directly in the slow cooker. Pour in the blended queso sauce, stir well, cover, and cook on LOW for 30 minutes.
Melt the Cheese: stir in 200 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese until fully melted and creamy.
Prepare Rice & Assemble: cook 520 g Minute rice according to package directions. Stir in 1 cup chopped cilantro and juice + zest of 1 lime. Divide rice and queso chicken into 10 servings.

title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 400 g Minute white rice (≈2½ cups dry)
½ cup chicken bone broth (¼ cup for chicken + ¼ cup for sauce)
2 tsp Italian seasoning (1 tsp for chicken + 1 tsp for sauce)
Optional: pinch paprika or red pepper flakes
instructions: Add 4 lb chicken breast to the slow cooker. Season with 1-2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Pour ¼ cup bone broth over the top.
Cover and cook on HIGH for 4 hours (or LOW for 6-7 hours) until chicken is tender and shreddable.
In a blender, combine 550 g cottage cheese, 150 g cream cheese, ¼ cup bone broth, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, and 1 tbsp lemon juice. Blend until completely smooth.
With 1 hour remaining, add 60 g sun-dried tomatoes and 3-4 cups spinach directly to the slow cooker. Let wilt.
Shred the chicken in the crockpot. Pour in the blended sauce, then add ½ cup basil, 100 g parmesan, 150 g cheddar, and 150 g mozzarella. Cover and cook 20-30 minutes until creamy and thick.
Cook 400 g Minute rice separately per package directions. Fold cooked rice into the crockpot until fully coated. Portion into 10 containers.

title: Queso Taco Mac N Cheese
ingredients: 120 g Rico's Premium Cheddar Cheese Sauce
½ cup hot sauce or taco sauce (to taste)
1 Kraft Mac & Cheese cheese powder packet
instructions: Hit slow cooker with olive oil spray and then add 4lbs of 96/4 beef (optional break up the beef and brown first) to slow cooker.
Add 4 tbsp taco seasoning, ½ cup beef bone broth, and ½ cup hot/taco sauce to the slow cooker. Stir well. Cook HIGH 3-4 hours or LOW 6-7 hours.
In a blender, combine 900 g fat-free cottage cheese, 150 g reduced-fat cream cheese, 120 g Rico's cheddar cheese sauce, and 1 Kraft cheese powder packet. Blend until completely smooth.
With 30 minutes left on LOW, pour the blended queso sauce into the slow cooker along with 200 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar and 1 chopped red bell pepper. Stir to combine.
While queso finishes, cook 18 oz Protein+ pasta according to package directions. Drain well.
Fold cooked pasta into the slow cooker, stir until fully coated and creamy, then portion into 10 servings.

title: Buffalo Gameday Burritos
ingredients: 450 g instant white rice (≈2¼ cups dry)
2 packets Hidden Valley Ranch seasoning mix
15 Mission Carb Balance Whole Wheat tortillas
instructions: Add 5 lb chicken breast, 1½ cups buffalo sauce, 2 ranch packets, minced garlic, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper to the slow cooker. Stir to coat chicken evenly.
Cook HIGH 4-5 hours or LOW 6-7 hours, until chicken is tender and shreds easily.
In a blender, combine 300 g reduced-fat cream cheese, 500 g fat-free cottage cheese, and 2-3 tbsp liquid from the slow cooker. Blend until completely smooth.
Shred chicken directly in the slow cooker, then pour in the blended buffalo-cream sauce. Stir until chicken is fully coated and creamy.
Cook 450 g white rice according to package directions. Stir cooked rice and 350 g shredded cheddar into the slow cooker until thick and evenly combined.
Weigh the finished mixture, divide evenly into 15 portions, fill tortillas, wrap tightly, and store for meal prep or freezer.

title: Chipotle Queso Steak and Rice Bowls
ingredients: ½ cup chipotle peppers in adobo
¼ cup chipotle peppers in adobo
450 g instant white rice (dry, ≈9 cups cooked)
instructions: Add 4.25 lb flank steak, garlic powder, onion powder, salt & pepper, cumin, chili powder, ½ cup chipotle peppers, ½ cup ROTEL, and ½ cup bone broth to the slow cooker. Stir to coat steak evenly.
Cook HIGH 4 hours or LOW 7 hours, until steak is tender and easily shreds.
In a blender, combine 650 g cottage cheese, 200 g reduced-fat cream cheese, Kraft cheese powder, ¼ cup chipotle peppers, and 2-3 tbsp bone broth. Blend until silky smooth.
Cook 450 g dry rice according to package directions (yields ~9 cups cooked). Set aside. (Minute rice saves time.)
With 20 minutes left, shred steak in the slow cooker, stir in all cooked rice, then pour in the blended chipotle queso sauce. Mix thoroughly.
Top with reduced-fat shredded cheddar, switch heat to LOW, cover, and let melt for 20 minutes until creamy and fully combined. Portion into 10 servings, equally distributing the rice.

title: Queso Steak Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: 100 g Rico's Premium Cheddar Cheese Sauce
120 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar (added at the end)
instructions: Add 2.25 lb flank steak to the slow cooker. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, and ancho chili powder. Add 40 g chipotle peppers on top and pour in ½ cup bone broth.
Cook HIGH 3.5-4 hours or LOW 7-8 hours, until steak is tender and shreddable.
Shred steak directly in the slow cooker and mix into the chipotle broth.

In a blender, combine 600 g fat-free cottage cheese, 100 g Rico's cheddar sauce, and 100 g reduced-fat cream cheese. Blend until ultra-smooth, then pour over the shredded steak. Warm on LOW 10-15 minutes.
Cook 16 oz Banza shells according to package directions. Drain well.
Stir cooked pasta into the slow cooker, then add 120 g reduced-fat shredded cheddar. Mix until melted, creamy, and fully coated. Divide into 8 servings.

title: Queso Beefy Rice Burritos
ingredients: 6 g ancho chile powder (divided: blended + spice add-in)
instructions: Add 4 lb ground beef, 1 cup ROTEL, and ½ cup bone broth to the slow cooker. Stir, cover, and cook LOW 3 hours, breaking up beef halfway through. (Optional: just let it ride.)
Cook 300 g instant white rice according to package directions until fluffy. Set aside.
In a blender, combine 650 g cottage cheese, 100 g Rico's cheese, 120 g reduced-fat cream cheese, 4 tbsp taco seasoning, and ancho chile powder. Blend until thick and ultra-smooth.
Stir cooked rice into the beef, then pour in the blended queso.
Add 250g reduced-fat shredded cheddar, stir, and let melt on LOW 10-15 minutes until creamy and cohesive.
Divide mixture evenly into 18 portions, fill tortillas, roll tight, and store for meal prep or freezer.

title: Creamy Tuscan Steak and Pasta
ingredients: 20 oz Barilla Protein+ pasta, cooked separately
instructions: Add 4 lb top round steak, 2 cups bone broth, Italian seasoning, basil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the slow cooker. (Use olive oil spray first.)
Cook LOW 6-7 hours or HIGH 3.5-4 hours, until steak is fork-tender.
Shred steak directly in the slow cooker using two forks.
In a blender, combine 1,000g fat-free cottage cheese, 250g ricotta, 2 tbsp tomato paste, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, and salt & pepper. Blend until smooth.
Stir blended sauce into shredded steak, then add sun-dried tomatoes and spinach. Cover and cook LOW 30 minutes.
Turn heat off, stir in 100 g mozzarella until melted, then fold in cooked Protein+ pasta or portion pasta separately.

title: Maple Bacon Donut
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup kodiak cake mix, 1/2 cup almond milk, 75g egg white, 16g protein powder, 4 tbsp raw stevia and whisk together. (Consistency should slowly drip off of whisk or fork.)

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. This recipe should make 6 even donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)
Air fry to crisp, or pan fry 4 slices of turkey bacon (your desired crispiness), chop into small slices.
Icing: combine 4-5 tbsp of powdered monk fruit powder with approximately 12ml almond milk.
Let donuts cool on rack for 5 minutes. Dip top of donuts into icing. Place on bacon evenly. Pour 1 tbsp blue agave over the top and enjoy.
macroNote: No calorie/macro totals were printed for this recipe in the source book.

title: Birthday Party Donut
ingredients: 4 TBSP stevia (or sugar free sweetener of your choice)
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup kodiak cake mix, 200ml almond milk, 50g egg white, 1/2 scoop vanilla protein powder, 4 tbsp raw stevia and whisk together. (Consistency should slowly drip off of whisk or fork.)

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. This recipe should make 6 even donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)

Making icing: combine 6 tbsp of a powdered sugar free sweetener. (Lakanto is the brand I use.) Add 15-20ml of almond milk and whisk together. (Repeat same step to make chocolate frosting but add 5g chocolate cocoa.)
Once donuts are finished, carefully remove and let them rest 25 minutes.
Dip them upside down into your icing, than spread 9g of sprinkles across each donut.

title: Cinnamon Crunch Donut
ingredients: Fat Free Greek Yogurt, Plain, 130 gram(s)
Six Star Pro Nutrition Triple Chocolate Whey Protein Powder Mix, 0.5 scoop
Almond Non Dairy Beverage, Vanilla, 1 cup
Catalina Toast Crunch cereal (or generic cereal)
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup of self rising flour in a bowl with 130 gram(s) nonfat greek yogurt. Work these two ingredients together until it feels like a ball of dough. Add 1/2 scoop of chocolate protein powder and 200 ML almond milk. Add 4 TBSP of stevia to make it sweeter. Work all ingredients into a batter.

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. This recipe should make 6 even donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)
Make your chocolate frosting. Combine 1 serving hershey cocoa, 5 tbsp powdered monk fruit sugar, and approximately 10-15ml almond milk. Whisk together until a frosting forms.
Once donuts are cooled. Dip into your chocolate frosting. Add a total of 30g of your cinnamon toast crunch across all 6 donuts. Finish with a dash of cinnamon across the tops of each one.

title: PB and Yay Donut
ingredients: Lucky Leaf Red Raspberry Pie Filling, 42 gram
Protein One Protein Bar, Peanut Butter Chocolate, 1 bar
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup kodiak cake mix, 1/2 cup almond milk, 75g egg white, 16g protein powder, 4 tbsp raw stevia and whisk together. (Consistency should slowly drip off of whisk or fork.)

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. Add a chopped up protein/peanut butter chocolate protein bar evenly across 6 donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)
Measure out 6 tbsp of pb fit powder into a separate bowl, add stevia to taste and 2 tbsp monkfruit powdered sugar.

Once donuts are baked, let cool for 20 minutes before adding toppings. Then dip each donut into the peanut butter topping. Drizzle on 42g of red raspberry pie filling evenly across all 6 donuts (approximately 6g for each).
Enjoy! Refrigerate or freeze!

title: French Vanilla Crumble Donut
ingredients: Purely Inspired Organic Protein, French Vanilla, 1 scoop
Philadelphia ⅓ Less Fat Cream Cheese, 40 gram(s)
12 crispy crunchy chocolate chip cookies (Trader Joe's)
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup kodiak powder, 90g nonfat greek yogurt, 120ml almond milk, 100g egg white, 5 tbsp stevia, 1/2 scoop protein powder and whisk together into a smooth batter.

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. This recipe should make 6 even donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)
Making the frosting: in a food processor, blend 160g nonfat greek yogurt, 5 tbsp stevia, 1/2 scoop protein vanilla protein powder, 40g 1/3 reduced fat cream cheese.
After the donuts have rested (20 minutes) spread the frosting evenly across all 6 donuts.
Crush up 12 donuts (cookies) into a small baggy and evenly spread across all 6 donuts.
Enjoy! Place in the refrigerator for 3-4 days or freeze them to enjoy later.

title: Pancakes and Ice Cream Donut
ingredients: Blue Diamond Almond Breeze Almond milk, 120ML
Purely Inspired Organic Protein, French Vanilla, 0.5 scoop
Bob Evans Grocery Liquid Egg Whites, 63 gram(s)
1 serving low cal ice cream (Halo Top)
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup kodiak powder, 4 tbsp stevia, 120ML almond milk, 1/2 scoop vanilla whey, 63g egg white, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, tbsp cinnamon.

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. This recipe should make 6 even donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)

Place donuts on a cooling rack for approximately 20 minutes. Once cooled, drizzle on some low cal agave syrup. Finish by dusting with powdered monkfruit sugar. Add 1 serving of Halo Top ice cream of your choice.
macroNote: 336 calories, 12g protein listed for (3) donuts plus one serving of ice cream.

title: Pixie Stardust Nutty Donut
ingredients: Purely Inspired Organic Protein, French Vanilla, 1 scoop
Bob Evans Grocery Liquid Egg Whites, 100 g
Philadelphia ⅓ Less Fat Cream Cheese, 40 gram(s)
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup kodiak powder, 90g nonfat greek yogurt, 120ML almond milk, 100g egg white, 5 tbsp stevia, 1/2 scoop protein powder and whisk together into a smooth batter.

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. This recipe should make 6 even donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)
Making the frosting: in a food processor, blend 160g nonfat greek yogurt, 5 tbsp stevia, 1/2 scoop protein vanilla protein powder, 40g 1/3 reduced fat cream cheese.

After the donuts have rested (20 minutes) spread the frosting evenly across all 6 donuts. Additionally combine 3 tbsp pb fit powder with 2-3 tbsp of water. Mix with 3 packets of stevia. Drizzle over all 6 donuts.
Enjoy! Place in the refrigerator for 3-4 days or freeze them to enjoy later. I like to eat them all in 3-4 days.

title: Tomcat Glazer Donut
ingredients: Blue Diamond Almond Breeze Almond milk, 0.8 cup
Purely Inspired Organic Protein, French Vanilla, 0.5 scoop
Bob Evans Grocery Liquid Egg Whites, 63 gram(s)
instructions: Batter: combine 1 cup kodiak cake mix, 1/2 cup almond milk, 75g egg white, 16g protein powder, 4 tbsp raw stevia and whisk together. (Consistency should slowly drip off of whisk or fork.)

Spray donut pan with nonstick spray thoroughly. Pour evenly into Donut Pan. This recipe should make 6 even donuts. Bake for 375 for approximately 8-10 minutes. (Poke with fork to check if the inside of donut is cooked.)
Make the icing: combine 8 tbsp lankato powdered monkruit sugar with 12-15 ML almond milk. Whisk together.
Once donuts are cooled, simply dunk top and bottom and enjoy! Simple and tasty!
Keep refrigerated!
macroNote: No calorie/macro totals were printed for this recipe in the source book.

title: Bang Bang Chicken and Macaroni
instructions: Step 1: Prep the Chicken. Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Season 32 oz. skinless chicken breast with all-purpose seasoning to taste. Place on a lined baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until fully cooked. Let it rest, then slice or cube.

Step 2: Make the Bang Bang Sauce. In a bowl, mix 200g nonfat Greek yogurt with 1/2 cup sriracha sauce (use 1/4 cup if you don't like it spicy). Stir until smooth and set aside. Once the chicken is cooked and cut, toss it in the Bang Bang sauce until evenly coated.
Step 3: Cook the Noodles. Boil 8 oz. Banza noodles according to package instructions. Drain and return to the pot.

Step 4: Make the Cheese Sauce. To the cooked noodles, add 1/3 cup fat-free Fairlife milk, 125g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, 1/2 packet Kraft macaroni & cheese powder, and 3 slices Velveeta cheese. Stir over low heat until everything melts and is well combined.

Cook 7 slices center cut bacon until crispy. Chop or crumble into pieces. Mix the bacon into the mac & cheese or sprinkle on top when serving. Serve the Bang Bang Chicken on the side or over the mac & cheese. (Separate into 7 servings.)

title: Cheese Steak Skillet Bowls
ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic seasoning, paprika (to taste)
Chipotle yogurt sauce: 300g nonfat Greek yogurt
instructions: Step 1: Prep & Air Fry the Potatoes. Dice 4 medium russet potatoes into small cubes. Soak them in cold water for 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Spray with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic seasoning, and paprika. Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 20-30 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until golden and crispy.

Step 2: Cook the Steak & Veggies. Spray a skillet with olive oil and heat over medium-high. Add 32 oz. thinly sliced sirloin steak and cook until browned (do this in batches). Add 1 sliced white onion and 8 sliced jalapeños. Cook everything together until soft and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes.

Step 3: Make the Chipotle Yogurt Sauce. In a blender, combine 300g nonfat Greek yogurt, 50g chipotles in adobo, 1-2 cloves fresh garlic, a splash of lime juice, and fresh cilantro. Blend until smooth. Chill in the fridge while everything finishes cooking.

Step 4: Combine in the Skillet. Add the air-fried potatoes to the skillet with the steak and veggies. Mix everything well. Sprinkle 120g mozzarella and 120g cheddar evenly on top. Cover with a lid or foil and let it melt on low heat for 3-5 minutes.
Step 5: Serve & Top with Sauce. Divide the skillet into 6 portions. Drizzle each with the chipotle yogurt sauce or serve it on the side.

title: Buffalo Ranch Protein Bowl
ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika (to taste)
32 oz. raw skinless chicken breast, cubed
Splash of fat-free milk (if needed, to thin sauce)
instructions: Step 1: Prep & Air Fry the Potatoes. Cube 3 medium russet potatoes and soak in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry. Spray with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 20-30 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy.
Step 2: Cook the Chicken. Season 32 oz. cubed chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder. Cook in a skillet over medium heat until fully cooked through and browned.

Step 3: Make the Buffalo Sauce Mix. Lower the heat and add 1 cup Frank's RedHot Buffalo sauce and 60g reduced-fat cream cheese to the chicken. Stir until the cream cheese melts and the sauce is smooth. Add a splash of fat-free milk if needed to thin it out.

Step 4: Cook the Bacon & Combine. Cook 14 slices of center cut bacon until crispy, then chop or crumble. In a large bowl or pan, combine the crispy potatoes, saucy chicken, and chopped bacon. Mix well.

Step 5: Top with Cheese & Finish. Sprinkle 120g cheddar and 120g mozzarella cheese over the top of the mixture. Cover and let it melt for a few minutes over low heat. Divide evenly into 6 bowls or containers.

Optional Ranch over the top: blend 300g nonfat greek yogurt, 3 garlic cloves, 1tbsp onion powder, 3 tbsp ranch seasoning, splash of lemon and a splash of fat free milk for a tasty protein ranch you can place in the fridge and enjoy for a couple days with these bowls.

title: High Protein Hamburger Helper
instructions: Step 1: Season the Meat. Add 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 4 tbsp ground mustard, salt, and pepper to taste. Stir to coat everything evenly.

Step 2: Cook the Ground Beef. In a large skillet over medium heat, cook 32 oz. 93/7 ground beef until browned. Drain any excess fat. Add 1/2 cup chopped onion and 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper. Cook for 3-5 minutes until softened.
Step 3: Make the Sauce. Add 1 cup tomato sauce, 1 cup chicken broth, 100 ml evaporated milk, and 60g cream cheese. Stir well and simmer on low until smooth and creamy.
Step 4: Cook the Banza Noodles. Boil 7 servings of Banza protein noodles according to the package directions. Drain and mix into the skillet with the beef and sauce.
Step 5: Add Cheese & Finish. Sprinkle 120g reduced-fat mozzarella over the top. Cover with a lid and let melt for 2-3 minutes. Stir once more and divide into 7 portions for meal prep.

title: Breakfast Taco Bowls
ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, taco seasoning (to taste)
instructions: Step 1: Prep & Air Fry the Potatoes. Dice 3-4 medium russet potatoes and soak in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry. Spray with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and taco seasoning. Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 20-30 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy.

Step 2: Cook the Ground Beef & Peppers. In a large skillet, cook 32 oz. lean ground beef over medium heat until browned. Drain excess fat if needed. Add 1 cubed red bell pepper and 1 cubed green bell pepper. Season with taco seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook until veggies are soft, about 5-6 minutes.

Step 3: Scramble the Egg Whites. In a separate pan, spray with olive oil and pour in 4 cups (400g) egg whites. Season lightly with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Cook on medium-low heat, stirring gently until fully cooked through and fluffy.
Step 4: Assemble the Bowls. In each of 8 containers, layer air-fried potatoes, scrambled egg whites, and taco beef with peppers. Sprinkle each with a little chopped cilantro.
Step 5: Add Cheese & Avocado. Top each bowl with shredded cheddar (140g total across all bowls). Finish by evenly spreading 140g avocado over the 8 servings as garnish.

title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Bowls
ingredients: Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, Cajun seasoning (to taste)
Yogurt ranch sauce: 300g nonfat Greek yogurt
Garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper (to taste)
instructions: Step 1: Prep & Air Fry the Potatoes. Dice 3-4 medium russet potatoes and soak in cold water for 30 minutes. Drain and pat dry. Spray with olive oil and season with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and Cajun seasoning. Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 20-30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy and golden.

Step 2: Cook the Chicken. Season 32 oz. cubed chicken breast with garlic powder, onion powder, Cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook in a skillet with olive oil spray over medium heat until browned and fully cooked.
Step 3: Cook Bacon & Steam Broccoli. Cook 8 slices of center cut bacon until crispy, then chop or crumble. Steam 1 cup broccoli until tender but still bright green.

Step 4: Make the Yogurt Ranch Sauce. In a blender or bowl, mix 300g Greek yogurt, 3 minced garlic cloves, a splash of lemon juice, 30ml fat-free milk, 3-4 tbsp ranch seasoning, and season with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Blend or stir until smooth. Chill while prepping.

Step 5: Assemble the Bowls. In each of 6 containers, layer air-fried potatoes, cooked chicken, steamed broccoli, and crumbled bacon. Drizzle or serve with yogurt ranch sauce. Sprinkle each with some of the 120g cheddar cheese.

title: Steak Bites and Buffalo Mac
ingredients: 80g (1 cup) Frank's Red Hot Buffalo sauce
instructions: Step 1: Cook the Pasta. Boil 6 servings of Banza protein pasta according to the package directions. Drain and set aside.
Step 2: Cook the Bacon. In a skillet, cook 6 slices of center cut bacon until crispy. Remove, chop or crumble, and set aside.

Step 3: Sear the Steak Bites. Season 32 oz. cubed sirloin with steak seasoning, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. In the same pan with a bit of the bacon grease or olive oil spray, sear the steak on high heat until browned and cooked to your preferred doneness. Remove from heat and rest.

Step 4: Make the Buffalo Cheese Sauce. In a pan over low heat, combine 80ml (1/2 cup) fat-free milk, 80g (1 cup) Frank's Buffalo sauce, 1/2 packet Kraft cheese powder, and 160g shredded cheddar. Stir until melted and smooth.
Step 5: Combine & Serve. Add the cooked pasta to the buffalo cheese sauce and stir to coat. Divide evenly into 6 bowls or containers. Top each with steak bites and crumbled bacon.

title: Nacho Cheese Dip Bowl
instructions: Step 1: Cook the Beef. In a skillet, sauté 1 diced onion until soft. Add 2 lbs 95/5 ground beef, cook until browned, drain fat, and season with taco seasoning to taste.

Step 2: Make the High-Protein Queso. Blend 300g fat-free cottage cheese, 56g reduced-fat cheddar, 1/2 packet Kraft cheese powder, 2 minced garlic cloves, 40g chipotle in adobo, and 40ml fat-free Fairlife milk until smooth.
Step 3: Combine. Add queso to the beef, stir in 120g reduced-fat cheddar, and mix until fully melted and creamy.
Step 4: Cilantro Lime Rice. Mix 6 cups cooked jasmine rice with chopped fresh cilantro and lime juice to taste.
Step 5: Avocado Cilantro Lime Sauce. Blend 250g nonfat Greek yogurt, 3 minced garlic cloves, fresh cilantro, juice of 1 lime (or to taste), and 1/2 avocado until smooth.
Step 6: Assemble. Layer bowls with cilantro lime rice, cheesy beef, and a drizzle of avocado sauce. Garnish with extra cilantro and enjoy warm.

title: Pizza Protein Bowls
instructions: Step 1: Prep the Potatoes. Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Wash and cut the russet potatoes into bite-sized cubes. Toss them in a bowl with olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. (Soak in cold water for 20-30 mins and pat dry before cooking.)

Step 2: Bake the Potatoes. Spread the seasoned potato cubes on a baking sheet in a single layer. Bake in the preheated oven for about 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy, tossing halfway through.

Step 3: Cook the Beef. While the potatoes are baking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the 95/5 beef, breaking it apart with a spatula. Season with garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook until browned, about 7-10 minutes. Drain any excess fat if necessary.

Step 4: Prepare the Bacon. In another skillet, cook the center cut bacon until crispy. Remove and let it drain on paper towels. Once cooled, crumble into pieces. In the same skillet, briefly sauté the Canadian bacon for added flavor.
Step 5: Combine Meats. Add the crumbled center cut bacon and sautéed Canadian bacon to the cooked beef in the skillet. Stir to combine, allowing flavors to meld for a couple of minutes.

Step 6: Assemble the Bowls. Once the potatoes are done, divide them among 7 bowls. Top each with the beef and bacon mixture. Pour marinara sauce over the top, then add a slice of provolone cheese on each bowl.

Step 7: Melt the Cheese. Return the bowls to the oven (or use the broiler) for about 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Once done, sprinkle the reduced fat mozzarella over each bowl, allowing it to melt slightly. Serve hot.

title: Garlic Steak Bites with Cheesy Cajun Broccoli Orzo
ingredients: 7 servings orzo protein rice from Barilla
instructions: Prepare the Steak: season the sirloin steak with Cajun seasoning, garlic seasoning, and minced garlic. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the Orzo/Rice: in a pot, cook the orzo or rice according to package instructions. Add the broccoli during the last 3-4 minutes of cooking. Drain and set aside.
Make the Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine the fat-free cottage cheese, reduced-fat cheddar, fat-free milk, and a pinch of Cajun seasoning. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Grill the Steak: preheat your grill to medium-high. Grill the marinated steak for about 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired doneness. Remove from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing into bite-sized pieces.
Combine Orzo and Sauce: in the pot you used for the orzo/rice, add the cheese sauce and stir until well combined. Heat gently if necessary.
Add Steak: gently fold in the grilled steak bites into the cheesy orzo mixture, ensuring everything is evenly coated.
Serve and Portion: divide the dish into 6 servings and plate them. Enjoy!

title: Cheesy Cajun Crispy Potatoes with Sausage and Steak Bowls
ingredients: 7 Open Nature garlic red pepper sausages
200 g nonfat Greek yogurt-based sauce of your choice
instructions: Prep & Air Fry the Potatoes. Preheat air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Wash and dice russet potatoes into bite-sized chunks, then pat completely dry. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning to taste. Air fry for 20-25 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crispy.
Cook the Sausage. While potatoes cook, heat a skillet over medium heat. Slice garlic red pepper sausages, then sear in the skillet for 5-7 minutes, until browned. Set aside.

Cook the Steak. Cube sirloin steak, then season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Cajun seasoning. In the same skillet, sear steak over medium-high heat for 3-5 minutes per side, or until desired doneness. Let rest before slicing.

Assemble the Bowls. In 6 meal prep containers, divide the air-fried potatoes, cooked sausage, and steak slices evenly. Top with a sprinkle of reduced-fat cheddar cheese. Drizzle with your Greek yogurt-based sauce for added flavor.
Store & Serve. Refrigerate for up to 2 days, or freeze for later.

title: Surf N Turf Cajun Mac
instructions: Cook the Pasta. In a large pot, bring salted water to a boil and cook the protein pasta for 8-10 minutes, then drain.

Sauté Sausage and Shrimp. In a large skillet over medium heat, add the sliced sausage. Cook for about 5 minutes until browned. Add the shrimp, Cajun seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Cook until the shrimp are pink and cooked through (about 5-7 minutes). Remove from heat.

Make the Mac Sauce. In a blender, combine the fat-free cottage cheese, 100g reduced-fat cheese (reserving 40g), fat-free Fairlife milk, and additional Cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper, and 1/2 Kraft Mac and cheese packet. Blend until smooth.
Combine Ingredients. In a large bowl, mix the cooked pasta with the sautéed sausage and shrimp. Pour the mac sauce over the mixture and stir until well combined.

Serve. Divide the mixture into bowls. Top with the reserved 40g of reduced-fat cheese and sliced jalapeños. You can place under the broiler for a couple of minutes for a melted topping, if desired. Enjoy!

title: Chipotle Rice Steak Bowls
ingredients: 7 slices center-cut bacon, cooked and chopped
instructions: Cook the Orzo: in a large pot, bring 8 cups of salted water to a boil. Add 12 oz chickpea orzo and cook according to package instructions (usually 8-10 minutes). Drain and set aside.

Prepare the Steak: pat dry 32 oz sirloin steak, then season evenly with 1 tsp each of Monterey, taco, and fajita seasoning. Heat a skillet over medium-high and sear steak for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired doneness. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.

Sauté the Veggies: in the same skillet, add a little oil if needed, then sauté 1 diced white onion, 1 diced green bell pepper, and 1 diced red bell pepper over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, until softened and lightly browned. Remove from heat.

Make the Creamy Chipotle Sauce: in a blender, combine 1 packet cheese powder, 3 minced garlic cloves, 300g cottage cheese, and 50g minced chipotles in adobo. Blend until completely smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed (a pinch of salt or dash of taco seasoning works well).

Assemble the Bowls: divide the cooked orzo evenly between 6 bowls (about 1 cup per bowl). Top each with sautéed veggies, sliced steak, and about 1 slice of chopped bacon. Drizzle with creamy chipotle sauce and finish each bowl with 30-35g shredded cheddar (roughly 1/4 cup). Serve hot and enjoy!

title: Taco Truck Protein Bowl
ingredients: 6 tbsp nacho cheese (about 1.2 tbsp per bowl)
Store-bought or homemade pico de gallo
Fire ranch sauce: 300g nonfat Greek yogurt
instructions: Blend Sauce: in a blender, combine 300g Greek yogurt, 3 garlic cloves, juice of 1 lime, 2 tbsp fire sauce, 50g chipotle in adobo, 3 tbsp ranch seasoning, and 50ml fat-free milk. Blend until smooth and chill.

Roast Potatoes: preheat oven to 400°F. Dice 3 medium russet potatoes, boil 3 mins, drain, pat dry. Toss with olive oil spray, salt, pepper, paprika, and taco seasoning. Roast on a baking sheet for 30 minutes, flipping halfway.
Cook Steak: season 32 oz top round steak with taco seasoning, salt, and pepper. Griddle or pan-sear over medium-high heat, 4-5 minutes per side. Rest 5 mins, then dice.
Fry Eggs: lightly oil a pan and cook 10 eggs (sunny-side up or scrambled). Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Assemble Bowls: in each of 5 bowls, add 1/5 of the potatoes, 6.4 oz steak, 2 eggs, 16g cheddar, 1.2 tbsp nacho cheese, spoonful of pico de gallo, and a drizzle of fire ranch sauce.

title: California Burrito Bowls
ingredients: 3.5 medium russet potatoes, peeled and cut into fries
12 tbsp nacho cheese (2 tbsp per bowl)
instructions: Grill the Tri-Tip: preheat grill to medium-high. Season 32 oz tri-tip generously with taco seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Grill for about 12 minutes per side for medium-rare (internal temp 135°F+). Remove and let rest for 10 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.

Make the Fries: preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss 3.5 peeled russet potatoes (cut into fries) with a little olive oil, salt, pepper, and paprika. Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy and golden.
Prep the Cheese Mix: in a small bowl, combine 80g reduced-fat cheddar and 120g fat-free mozzarella. Set aside.
Dice the Avocados: slice and dice 2 ripe avocados while the fries bake and steak rests.
Assemble the Bowls: in each of the 6 bowls, start with a base of crispy fries, add sliced tri-tip, sprinkle on the cheddar-mozzarella cheese blend, and drizzle with 2 tbsp nacho cheese.
Finish & Serve: top with diced avocado and a drizzle of homemade chipotle sauce (about 50g per bowl). Serve hot. Store in the fridge for 2-3 days or freeze for longer storage.

title: Garlic Parmesan Potato Bowls
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed
instructions: Make the Garlic Parmesan Sauce: in a bowl, whisk together 200g Greek yogurt, 30g light mayo, 28g shredded Parmesan, 1 tbsp garlic parmesan seasoning, black pepper, a splash of lemon juice, and a splash of light milk. Mix until smooth and creamy. Refrigerate until ready to use.

Season 2 lbs cubed chicken breast with paprika, salt, pepper, and lemon pepper. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, melt 2 tbsp light butter. Add chicken and cook for 7-9 minutes until golden and cooked through. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Boil 3 cubed russet potatoes for 3 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Toss with salt, pepper, garlic parmesan seasoning, and a light spray of olive oil.
Air Fry the Potatoes: preheat air fryer to 400°F. Cook the seasoned potatoes for 30 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy and golden.

Assemble the Bowls: toss the crispy potatoes with the garlic parmesan sauce until fully coated. Divide evenly into 5 portions along with the cooked chicken. Garnish with parsley or extra Parmesan if desired.

title: Smash Burger Bowls
ingredients: 1-2 tbsp cooked jalapeño and onion (from main batch)
instructions: Dice 3 medium russet potatoes and boil for 3 minutes. Drain and pat dry. Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of garlic powder.
Air fry at 400°F for 25-30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy and golden.

Cook the Bacon, Jalapeños & Onions: in a large skillet, cook 12 slices center-cut bacon until crisp. Set aside on paper towel. In the leftover bacon grease, sauté 2 sliced onions and 8 sliced jalapeños until caramelized (about 8-10 minutes). Set aside 1-2 tbsp for the ranch sauce.

In a blender or small food processor, combine 1-2 tbsp of the cooked jalapeño/onion mix, 1-2 tbsp ranch dressing, 1 tbsp taco seasoning, 50ml fat-free milk, 2 garlic cloves, 300g Greek yogurt, and 1 tbsp light mayo. Blend until smooth and creamy. Refrigerate until serving.
Form the 32 oz ground beef into 5 loose balls. Smash them into a hot skillet and cook 2-3 minutes per side. Add 2 slices of thin cheddar to each patty during the final minute. Let melt.

Assemble the Bowls: in each bowl, layer a base of crispy potatoes, followed by one smashed cheddar patty. Top with sautéed jalapeños & onions, crumbled bacon, and a sprinkle of 24g reduced-fat cheddar per bowl. Finish with a generous drizzle of jalapeño ranch.

title: Enchilada Chicken Bowls
ingredients: 3 medium russet potatoes, washed and diced
1 ripe avocado, sliced or diced (add right before serving)
instructions: Dice 3 medium russet potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Boil for 3 minutes in salted water, then drain and pat dry.
Toss with 1 tsp paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Air fry at 400°F for 20-25 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crispy.
Cube 32 oz of chicken breast and season with 1.5 tsp taco seasoning and a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook in a skillet over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, until browned and fully cooked.
Pour in 1.5 cups enchilada sauce, reduce heat, and simmer for 3-4 minutes until thickened and chicken is fully coated.

Blend the Nacho Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine 300g fat-free cottage cheese, 60g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, 50ml fat-free Fairlife milk, 1 packet Kraft cheese powder, 2 tbsp chopped jalapeños, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Blend until completely smooth. Transfer to a small saucepan and heat on low, stirring occasionally until hot and creamy. Add a bit more shredded cheddar if desired for thickness.

Assemble the Bowls: divide crispy potatoes into 6 bowls (about 1/2 cup each). Top each with enchilada chicken, a generous drizzle of the nacho cheese sauce, 10g reduced-fat cheddar, and a few slices of fresh avocado.

title: Beef Mongolian Noodles
ingredients: 2 tbsp zero-cal brown sugar (stevia or monk fruit)
1/2 tsp ground ginger or ginger seasoning
instructions: Cook the Pasta: bring a pot of water to a boil. Cook 10 oz Barilla angel hair pasta according to package instructions (about 3-4 minutes). Drain and set aside.
In a bowl, toss 32 oz thinly shaved top sirloin with 1/2 tsp baking soda. Let sit for 10 minutes to tenderize. Pat dry with paper towels.
Make the Sauce: in a small bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1-2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1-2 tbsp hoisin sauce, 2 tbsp zero-cal sweetener, and 1/2 tsp ginger seasoning.

Cook the Beef & Veggies: heat a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high. Sear beef in batches for 1-2 minutes per side until browned. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté sliced red and white bell peppers for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.

Combine & Finish: add cooked pasta and beef back to the pan. Pour in sauce and toss everything together until evenly coated and heated through. Top each bowl with chopped green onion and a light drizzle of sriracha mayo.

title: Creamy Cajun Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 9.5 oz Barilla Protein Angel Hair Pasta (dry)
Cajun seasoning, lemon pepper, garlic powder, paprika, Italian seasoning (to taste)
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook 9.5 oz Barilla protein pasta according to package directions (about 3-4 minutes). Drain and set aside, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add olive oil. Season 2 lbs cubed chicken with Cajun seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, lemon pepper, and Italian seasoning. Cook for 7-10 minutes until browned and fully cooked. Remove from pan and set aside.
In the same skillet, add a bit more oil if needed. Sauté 1/2 chopped white onion and 4 chopped garlic cloves for 3-4 minutes until fragrant and softened.

To the skillet, add 250 ml evaporated milk, 100 ml chicken stock, and 100g cream cheese. Stir continuously until the cream cheese melts and the sauce becomes smooth. Simmer for 3-5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in 50g shredded Parmesan and 40g mozzarella. Mix until melted and fully incorporated into the sauce.
Return the cooked chicken to the pan. Add the drained pasta and toss everything to coat. Add a splash of reserved pasta water to thin the sauce if needed. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Divide evenly into 5 servings. Optional: top with extra Parmesan or a light dusting of Cajun seasoning before serving.

title: Buffalo Nuggets Macaroni
ingredients: 32 oz chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 lb elbow macaroni (optional - for mac base)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Season 32 oz chicken pieces with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Dip into 2 whisked eggs, then coat in 60g crushed corn flakes. Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy and fully cooked.
Cook the Bacon: while chicken bakes, cook 5 slices center-cut bacon in a skillet until crispy. Drain on paper towel and set aside.

Make the Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine 400g cottage cheese, 70g reduced-fat cheddar, 50ml Fairlife milk, and 1 packet Kraft cheddar powder. Blend until smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Blend again briefly.
Mix the Buffalo Honey Sauce: in a bowl, mix 1 cup Frank's RedHot with 1 tbsp honey. Toss the baked chicken bites in the sauce until fully coated.
(Optional) Make the Mac & Cheese Base: cook 1 lb elbow macaroni per package directions. Drain and return to pot. Pour cheese sauce over the pasta and stir until fully coated.
