Separate into 6 containers and evenly distribute bacon, macaroni, and chicken bites.

title: Loaded Potato Nachos and Steak
ingredients: Seasonings: taco, onion powder, salt, pepper
instructions: Cook the Potatoes: dice 900g russet potatoes. Boil for 3-4 minutes, then drain and pat dry. Toss with olive oil spray, salt, and paprika. Air fry at 400°F for 25-30 minutes or until golden and crispy.
Cook the Steak: season 28 oz top sirloin with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Grill or sear in a skillet over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes per side or until desired doneness. Rest, then dice.
Sauté the Veggies: in a skillet, sauté 1 sliced red bell pepper and 1 sliced red onion over medium heat until tender and lightly caramelized (about 5-7 minutes).

Make the Nacho Cheese Sauce: blend together 300g nonfat cottage cheese, 80g reduced-fat cheddar, and 1 Kraft cheese packet. Heat gently in a pan on low heat until smooth and creamy. If needed thin out with fat free milk to desired consistency.
Assemble the Bowl: in each of the 5 bowls, add a layer of crispy potatoes, steak cubes, sautéed veggies, and top with warm nacho cheese sauce.

title: Cheese Steak Breakfast Bowls
ingredients: Garlic powder, pepper, salt, paprika, onion powder (to taste)
Chipotle sauce: 300g nonfat Greek yogurt (about 1⅓ cups)
instructions: Air Fry the Potatoes: preheat air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Boil cubed potatoes for 3 minutes, then pat dry. Toss cubed potatoes with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Air fry for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy.
Prepare the Chipotle Sauce: in a blender, combine 300g Greek yogurt, 55g chipotle in adobo, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1 tsp onion powder. Blend until smooth. Chill until ready to use.

Cook the Steak: season 2 lbs sirloin with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and paprika. Sear on a hot griddle for 3-5 minutes per side, or finish in the air fryer at 400°F for 10 minutes or until internal temp hits 135°F. Rest, then slice thinly.
Griddle the Veggies: dice red and green bell peppers and the onion. Sauté on the griddle with salt, pepper, and onion powder for 5-7 minutes until softened.
Fry the Eggs: in a nonstick pan over medium heat, fry 10 eggs to your preference. Season with salt and pepper.

Assemble the Bowls: layer crispy potatoes, sliced steak, and sautéed veggies in each bowl. Top with 1 fried egg, 1 slice provolone, a sprinkle of reduced-fat mozzarella, and 1 tbsp nacho cheese. Finish with a drizzle of chipotle sauce.

title: Queso Beef and Rice Bowls
ingredients: Taco seasoning (for beef and queso, to taste)
instructions: Cook the Right Rice: prepare 5 servings (5 cups of a rice of your choosing). I used Right Rice, a protein packed rice, but you can use regular brown or white. Just adjust macros accordingly.

Cook the Ground Beef: in a large skillet over medium heat, cook 32 oz lean ground beef until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess fat. Season with taco seasoning to taste and stir in 60g reduced-fat cheddar until melted and incorporated.

Blend the Queso Sauce: in a blender, combine 300g cottage cheese, 1/2 packet Kraft cheese powder, 1-2 tsp taco seasoning, and 40g reduced-fat cheddar. Blend until smooth. Add a splash of water if needed to thin to your desired consistency.
Prep the Veggies: dice 1 large tomato and 1 medium onion. Chop fresh cilantro. Slice lime into wedges for serving.

Assemble the Bowls: in each of 5 meal prep containers, layer Right Rice, taco beef, and queso sauce. Top with diced tomato, onion, a spoonful of guacamole (if using), chopped cilantro, and a lime wedge.

title: Orange Chicken and Chow Mein
ingredients: 25 oz chicken breast, diced (≈6.3 oz per serving)
10 oz Barilla angel hair pasta (≈2.5 oz dry per serving)
3-4 tbsp stevia or monk fruit sweetener
Corn starch slurry (1 tbsp corn starch + splash of water)
instructions: Cook the Pasta: boil 10 oz angel hair pasta for 3-4 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Make the Sauce: in a bowl, whisk together 2 tbsp orange zest, juice of 1 medium orange, 100 ml chicken stock, 120 ml soy sauce, 1 tbsp sriracha, 1 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 3 garlic cloves minced, and 3-4 tbsp sweetener, and corn starch slurry. Divide in half: half for orange chicken, half for chow mein.

Cook the Chicken: toss 25 oz diced chicken breast into egg yolk (1 egg) then place in a zip lock bag and toss with 60g of corn starch. Air fry until golden and cooked through (approximately 400 degrees for 20 mins or until internal temp reaches 165 or higher). Add 1/2 sauce into a pan at low heat and toss the chicken.
Cook the Veggies + Noodles: in a large pan or wok, sauté cabbage, carrot, celery, green onions, and garlic until tender. Add cooked noodles and the chow mein sauce. Toss well.
Assemble the Bowls: divide noodles + veggies and orange chicken evenly into 4 bowls. Top with extra green onions or a dash of sesame seeds if desired.

title: Crispy Garlic Lemon Chicken with Mac and Cheese
instructions: Air Fry the Chicken: beat 2 eggs in a bowl. In a separate container, add 35g cornstarch. Slice 32 oz chicken breast into strips, dip each piece in egg wash, then coat in cornstarch. Spray lightly with olive oil and air fry at 400°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Cook the Pasta: boil 10 oz chickpea penne according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Blend Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine 120g reduced-fat cheddar, 350g fat-free cottage cheese, 1/4 cup fat-free milk, 1/2 packet cheese powder. Blend until smooth and set aside.

Make the Lemon Garlic Sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat, combine 1/2 cup soy sauce, 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tsp honey, and juice of 1 lemon. Mix 30g cornstarch with a splash of water to create a slurry, then whisk it into the pan until the sauce thickens.
Coat Chicken in Sauce: toss air-fried chicken in the lemon garlic sauce until evenly coated.
Finish the Mac & Cheese: pour blended cheese sauce into a pan over low heat and stir until smooth and warm. Add cooked pasta and mix well. Season to taste.
Serve: divide evenly into 5 servings. One bowl = flavor, gains, and approval from the gym gods.

title: Queso Chicken and Rice Burritos
instructions: Cook & Shred the Chicken: preheat your air fryer to 375°F (190°C). Toss 32 oz cubed chicken breast with 3 tbsp taco seasoning, 1 tbsp garlic salt, and the zest and juice of 1 lime, and mix well. Place in a single layer and air fry for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and cooked through (165°F internal temp). Transfer to a food processor and pulse until shredded.

Prepare the Rice: in a saucepan, bring 2 cups chicken broth to a boil. Add 2 cups Minute Rice, 1/2 cup tomato paste, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp onion powder, 1-2 minced garlic cloves, and 2 tbsp chopped white onion. Season with salt and pepper to taste, reduce heat to low, cover, and let sit for 5 minutes or until broth is fully absorbed.

Make the Queso Sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat, combine 10 tbsp nacho cheese, 1/4 cup chicken broth, 1 cup 2% evaporated milk, 20g reduced-fat cheddar, 1 tbsp chopped jalapeño, and 1 tsp salt. Stir until smooth. Add 40g reduced-fat cream cheese and stir until melted and creamy.
Combine Everything: in a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, cooked rice mixture, and queso sauce. Stir until evenly coated and well mixed.

Build the Burritos: lay out 8 low-carb tortillas. Evenly divide the mixture across each. Top each with 15g reduced-fat cheddar (120g total). Wrap tightly into burritos, and grill, bake, or air fry for a crisp finish.

title: Alfredo Chicken with Wedges
ingredients: 5 slices center-cut bacon (plus 1 extra for topping)
Paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper (to taste)
Salt, pepper, and any other preferred seasonings
instructions: Cook the Chicken (Air Fry or Pan Fry): season 32 oz cubed raw chicken with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Air fry option: preheat to 400°F (190°C), cook for 15-18 minutes, flipping halfway. Pan fry option: sear chicken in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat with olive oil spray for 7-10 minutes until cooked through and golden brown. While it cooks, crisp 5 slices center-cut bacon. Crumble and set aside.

Prep & Cook the Potato Wedges: wash and cut 3 medium russet potatoes into wedges. Boil wedges for 3 minutes, then drain and pat completely dry with a paper towel — this helps them crisp up. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, and seasonings. Air fry at 400°F for 20-25 minutes, shaking halfway, OR bake at 425°F for 25-30 minutes, flipping at 15. For extra crisp, increase oven to 450°F for final 10 minutes.

Make the Alfredo Sauce: in a pan over medium heat, add 1 cup chicken stock and 1 cup 2% evaporated milk. Stir in 40g cream cheese, 120g reduced-fat mozzarella, and 28g Parmesan Reggiano. Stir constantly until fully melted, smooth, and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add Broccoli: stir in 1 cup pre-steamed broccoli, letting it simmer for 2-3 minutes to soak up the sauce. Remove from heat.
Combine Chicken & Sauce: add cooked chicken and 5 slices crumbled bacon to the Alfredo sauce. Toss to fully coat everything.
Serve It Up: plate the chicken Alfredo mix, top with extra 1 slice chopped bacon, and serve with crispy potato wedges on the side. Tastebud domination unlocked.

title: Korean Beef Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 32 oz top sirloin, cooked and shredded
3-4 tbsp sriracha (adjust to your spice level)
instructions: Cook the Pasta: boil 10 oz Banza shells according to package instructions. Drain, rinse, and set aside.
Make the Korean Beef: in a large pan over medium-high heat, add a small amount of oil (optional) and sauté 3-4 cloves minced garlic until fragrant (about 1 minute).
Add 32 oz shredded top sirloin and sear until it begins to brown. (Do it in batches.)
In a small bowl, whisk together 1 cup soy sauce, 1 tbsp Korean BBQ marinade, 3 tbsp zero-cal sweetener, 1 tbsp gochujang, 3-4 tbsp sriracha, 1 tbsp honey, and 1/2 cup chicken stock.
Pour over the beef, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally until thickened. Taste and adjust spice/sweetness if needed.

Make the Mac & Cheese: in a separate pot, combine 1 cup evaporated milk and 1 cup chicken stock over medium heat. Stir in 50g reduced-fat cream cheese until melted. Gradually add 150g shredded cheddar, stirring constantly until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Add the cooked pasta and stir until fully coated. If sauce thickens too much, loosen with a splash of milk or broth.
Serve It Up: plate a scoop of creamy mac & cheese and top with a generous portion of the spicy Korean beef. Garnish with sesame seeds or green onion if you're feeling fancy.

title: Buffalo Creamy Chicken Pasta
ingredients: Garlic powder, salt, pepper, paprika (to taste)
1 cup Frank's Red Hot Buffalo Sauce
instructions: Cook the Bacon: in a large pan, cook 7 slices of center-cut bacon until crispy. Set aside and crumble once cooled. Leave a small amount of bacon grease in the pan for flavor.

Cook the Chicken: season 32 oz chicken breast with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and paprika. Grill or sear on a griddle over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through (internal 165 or higher). Chop into bite-sized pieces.
Boil the Pasta: cook 11.5 oz Barilla Protein+ pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.

Make the Creamy Buffalo Sauce: in the bacon pan, add 1 cup Frank's Buffalo Sauce, 2 cups fat-free evaporated milk, and 1.5 cups chicken broth. Bring to a simmer. Stir in 50g reduced-fat cream cheese until melted and slightly thickened (about 5 minutes).
Add the Cheese: stir in 200g reduced-fat cheddar and continue stirring until the sauce is fully smooth and creamy.
Combine & Finish: add the cooked pasta, chopped chicken, and crumbled bacon into the buffalo sauce (feel free to garnish with blue cheese and adjust macros). Toss well to coat everything evenly.
Serve & Dominate: serve hot, garnish with extra bacon if you're feelin' wild. You can do it. And your taste buds will thank you.

title: Philly Steak Bites and High Protein Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 50 oz top sirloin or lean steak, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt, pepper, garlic powder (to taste, for potatoes)
instructions: Boil the Potatoes: add 4 peeled and cubed potatoes to a pot, cover with water, and add a pinch of salt. Boil for 10-15 minutes until fork-tender.

Cook the Steak Bites: while potatoes boil, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 50 oz cubed top sirloin and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Sauté the Peppers: add cubed red and green bell peppers to the skillet with the steak. Sauté for 2-3 minutes until just tender but still colorful.

Mash the Potatoes: drain the cooked potatoes and return to the pot. Add 1 cup fat-free milk and 1 cup nonfat Greek yogurt. Mash until smooth and creamy. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste.
Melt the Cheese: sprinkle 100g reduced-fat cheddar over the steak and peppers in the skillet. Cover with a lid for 1-2 minutes to melt the cheese over the steak bites.
Serve & Finish: plate a scoop of mashed potatoes. Top with cheesy steak and peppers. Finish with a drizzle of high-protein chipotle sauce for extra kick. (This recipe makes 7 servings.)

title: Ultimate Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Peel and dice 3 large russet potatoes. Spray a large skillet with oil and cook over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden brown and tender. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste. Remove and set aside.
Cook the Bacon & Sausage: in the same skillet, cook 8 slices of center-cut bacon until crispy. Remove and set aside.
Next, add 8 chicken sausage links and cook until browned and cooked through. Slice into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Sauté the Veggies: dice 1 onion and 1 bell pepper, then add to the skillet. Sauté for 4-5 minutes until softened.

Combine Everything: return the cooked potatoes, sliced chicken sausage, 18 slices Canadian bacon (chopped), and crumbled bacon to the skillet with the veggies. Stir well and cook together for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Pour in 700g egg whites. Season again with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Stir gently and cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes, until fully scrambled and set.
Sprinkle over 75g reduced-fat cheddar cheese and drizzle with 6 tbsp nacho cheese. Stir everything together and cook for 1-2 more minutes until melted and combined.

title: Hot Honey Sweet Potato Taco Bowls
instructions: Cook the Sweet Potatoes: peel and cube 900g sweet potatoes. Boil in salted water for about 10 minutes until soft. Drain and transfer to an air fryer. Air fry at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy. Season with 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, and 1 tsp paprika.
Cook the Ground Beef: add 21 oz 93/7 ground beef to a skillet over medium heat. Stir in 1 packet taco seasoning (add water if packet directs). Cook until beef is browned and fully seasoned.

Make the Egg Muffins: preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Spray a muffin tin. Pour 200g egg whites evenly into the cups. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until set. Top each muffin with 1 tbsp (about 30g total) fat-free cottage cheese and 5g reduced-fat cheddar cheese (total 20g cheese). Return to oven for 2-3 minutes to melt.
Make the Hot Honey Sauce: in a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp honey with hot sauce to taste.

Assemble the Bowls: in each bowl, layer crispy sweet potatoes, seasoned ground beef, and 1-2 egg muffins. Drizzle with hot honey sauce. Sprinkle with additional salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika to taste.
Serve hot while the muffins are warm and potatoes are crispy.

title: Cheddar Bacon Broccoli Alfredo
instructions: Cook the Pasta: boil 8 oz Banza chickpea pasta in salted water for 7-9 minutes, until al dente. Drain, reserve a bit of pasta water, and set aside.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place 8 slices center-cut bacon on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake for 15-20 minutes until crispy. Drain, crumble or chop, and set aside.

Brown the Beef: in a skillet over medium-high heat, cook 16 oz 95/5 lean ground beef for 6-8 minutes until fully browned. Season with 1/2 tsp paprika, salt, and pepper. Drain excess fat and set aside.
Steam the Broccoli: lightly steam or blanch 1 cup broccoli florets until just tender. Set aside.

Make the Alfredo Sauce: in a saucepan over medium heat, combine 100ml evaporated milk, 1/2 cup chicken bone broth, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, and 1 tsp Italian seasoning. Slowly whisk in 50g reduced-fat cheddar and 70g reduced-fat mozzarella until smooth and creamy.
Combine Everything: in the same saucepan, toss together the cooked pasta, ground beef, crumbled bacon, and steamed broccoli with the Alfredo sauce. Stir well to coat.

title: Greek Chicken Lemon Alfredo
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast (sliced or pounded evenly)
instructions: Season the Chicken: pat 2 lbs of chicken breast dry with paper towels. Season both sides generously with garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, sage, salt, and pepper.

Cook the Pasta: bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add 10 oz of Decocco fettuccine and cook according to package instructions until al dente, about 7-9 minutes. Drain the pasta and set it aside.

Pan-Fry the Chicken: heat a stainless steel pan over medium heat and lightly coat it with cooking spray or olive oil. Add the seasoned chicken and sear for 5-6 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest for a few minutes, then slice into strips.

Blend the Alfredo Sauce: in a blender, combine 200g of fat-free cottage cheese, 2 garlic cloves, 1/4 cup of 2% evaporated milk, 70g of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 28g of parmesan cheese, and 3 tablespoons of Alfredo seasoning mix. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Warm the Sauce: pour the blended sauce into a saucepan and place over low to medium heat. Stir frequently for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce is warmed through and slightly thickened. Adjust seasoning to taste if needed.

Assemble the Dish: toss the cooked fettuccine with the warm Alfredo sauce until well coated. Divide into bowls, top with sliced chicken, and garnish with fresh parsley or lemon zest if desired. Serve warm.

title: Cheddar Bacon Cajun Alfredo
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Sear the Steak & Bacon: cube 25 oz of sirloin steak and sear it in a hot stainless steel pan sprayed with avocado oil over high heat. Cook for about 4-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the steak is browned and crispy. Chop 5 slices of center-cut bacon and add them to the pan with the steak. Cook until the bacon is crispy, then remove both from the pan and set aside.
Cook the Pasta: bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add 9 oz of DeCecco cavatappi pasta and cook according to package instructions until al dente, usually 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.

Blend the Sauce: in a blender, combine 250g (1 cup) of fat-free cottage cheese, 70g (2.5 oz) of 1/3 reduced-fat cream cheese, 28g (1 oz) of parmesan cheese, 28g (1 oz) of reduced-fat cheddar, 1 garlic clove, 1/4 cup of 2% evaporated milk, 1/2 cup of chicken broth, 1 tsp of Cajun seasoning, and 3 tbsp of dry Alfredo seasoning mix. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Heat the Sauce: pour the blended sauce into a nonstick pan and warm it over medium-low heat. Stir gently for about 5 minutes, or until the sauce is fully heated and slightly thickened. Avoid boiling the sauce to prevent curdling.

Combine & Finish: add the cooked pasta, seared steak, crispy bacon, and 1 cup steamed broccoli to the warm sauce. Toss everything together until evenly coated. Taste and season with salt and black pepper as needed. Serve hot.

title: Green Chile Chicken Burritos
ingredients: 32 oz chicken breast, cooked and shredded
6 Mission Carb Balance whole wheat tortillas (110 cal each)
Optional seasonings: garlic powder, cumin, salt, smoked paprika, black pepper
instructions: Cook & Shred the Chicken: season 32 oz of chicken breast with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Grill or pan-sear the chicken over medium-high heat until cooked through, then shred it using two forks or a stand mixer.

Blend the Creamy Sauce: in a blender, combine 90g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 250g of nonfat cottage cheese, 4 tbsp (about half) of the Hatch green chiles, a pinch of salt, and a sprinkle of cumin. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Make the Cheesy Chicken Filling: in a large skillet over medium heat, combine the shredded chicken, the creamy blended sauce, 160g of shredded reduced-fat cheddar, and the remaining 4 tbsp of green chiles. Stir until the mixture is fully heated, cheesy, and melty.

Build the Burritos: warm 6 Mission Carb Balance tortillas slightly in a microwave or skillet. Spoon an equal portion of the cheesy chicken mixture into each tortilla, then top each with 1 slice of thin sharp cheddar.

Roll & Sear: roll each tortilla tightly into a burrito. Place seam-side down in a hot skillet sprayed with oil or in an air fryer at 400°F. Sear for 2-3 minutes per side (or air fry for 5-6 minutes), until golden and crispy on the outside.
Serve & Flex: slice, serve hot, and enjoy. These burritos store great for meal prep and taste even better the next day.

title: Tuscan Chicken and Creamy Rice
ingredients: 32 oz chicken breast, raw and skinless
instructions: Grill the Chicken: season 32 oz of raw chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and 1 tsp of smoked paprika. Grill the chicken until fully cooked and nicely charred on both sides. Once done, dice the grilled chicken into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Cook the Rice: prepare 3 cups of Minute Rice according to package instructions. Fluff with a fork and set aside while you make the sauce.

Blend the Creamy Sauce: in a blender, combine 70g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 250g of fat-free cottage cheese, 1/4 cup of evaporated 2% milk, 1/2 cup of chicken broth, 1 tbsp of Italian seasoning, 1 clove of garlic, and 1/2 packet of Kraft mac & cheese powder. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Simmer the Sauce: pour the blended sauce into a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in 28g of parmesan cheese and 56g of reduced-fat cheddar. Continue stirring until the cheeses melt and the sauce becomes creamy and well combined.

Combine Everything: to the skillet, add the diced grilled chicken, 3 cups of cooked rice, 40g of chopped sun-dried tomatoes, 1 cup of fresh spinach, and the remaining 3 cloves of minced garlic. Stir everything together until fully coated in the sauce. Let it simmer for 3-5 minutes to let the flavors combine and the spinach wilt.
Taste & Plate: adjust with salt and additional pepper to taste. Spoon the creamy Tuscan rice mixture into bowls and, if desired, top with a sprinkle of extra parmesan.

title: Honey Chipotle Chicken Nacho Potato Bowls
ingredients: Homemade taco seasoning (for chicken): 1 tsp paprika
instructions: Boil & Air Fry the Potatoes: dice 1200g of baking potatoes into bite-sized chunks. Boil in salted water for 3 minutes to par-cook, then drain and pat them dry. Season with salt, pepper, and a little garlic powder if desired. Lightly spray with cooking oil, then air fry at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking halfway, until crispy and golden brown.

Season & Cook the Chicken: coat 32 oz of raw chicken breast with the homemade taco seasoning blend: 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1/4 tsp oregano, and a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat until fully cooked through and nicely browned, about 5-6 minutes per side. Let the chicken rest for a few minutes, then slice.

Make the Honey Chipotle Sauce: in a blender, combine 7 chipotle peppers in adobo with 2 tbsp of honey and 1/2 cup of chicken broth. Blend until smooth, then pour into a saucepan and simmer over low heat for 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened.

Blend the Nacho Cheese Sauce: in a blender, combine 60g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 1/2 cup of evaporated 2% milk, 120g of reduced-fat cheddar, and 1/2 pouch of Kraft cheese powder. Blend until fully smooth. Pour the mixture into a saucepan and warm gently over low heat, stirring until melted and pourable.

Assemble the Bowl: in each serving bowl, start with a layer of crispy air-fried potatoes. Add sliced taco-seasoned chicken breast, drizzle generously with the honey chipotle sauce, and pour on the creamy nacho cheese.

title: Southwest Queso Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: Seasonings: chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt
Garlic powder & smoked paprika, to taste
instructions: Cook the Rice: start by cooking 3 cups dry white minute rice according to package instructions. Once cooked, set aside and keep warm.

Make the Queso Rice Base: to the hot rice, stir in 300g of nonfat cottage cheese, 60g of reduced-fat cream cheese, 80g of shredded reduced-fat cheddar cheese, 4 tsp of Kraft cheese powder, and 2 tbsp of Knorr Alfredo mix. Stir everything together until the rice becomes creamy and cheesy. Set aside.

Grill the Chicken: season 32 oz of raw chicken breast with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, and salt. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat until fully cooked and lightly charred. Once done, chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss into the queso rice mixture.
Add the Mix-Ins: stir 1/2 cup of black beans into the chicken and rice mixture. If using, add 1 cup of corn. Mix everything together in the same pan or bowl until evenly combined.

Make the Chipotle Yogurt Drizzle: in a small bowl, mix 3 tbsp of Greek yogurt with 1 tsp of chipotle in adobo, 1-2 tsp of lime juice, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and a splash of water to thin it out. Stir until smooth and creamy.

Assemble the Bowls: spoon the creamy queso chicken rice mixture into 6 meal prep containers or bowls. Top each with 1/6 of a sliced avocado and drizzle with the chipotle yogurt sauce just before serving.
